shared:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE restrained, appealing actual indie vocabulary tower-defense GAME SCREEN concept, NOT a marketing illustration, NOT a dashboard. Square image, 1024x1024 composition. This is a new mid-complexity art direction after rejection of both pastel generic UI and over-detailed fantasy illustrations. The key is a compact tactical BOARD readable in one glance. Orthographic straight overhead camera, no perspective. Upper 72% shows one bounded SQUARE 8x8 tile board centered with a very narrow plain surround. The entire board including all edges is visible. Low contrast thin grid lines. A continuous one-cell-wide bent enemy path snakes through the board from a clear entrance to a tiny gate, leaving LARGE CONTIGUOUS BUILDABLE INTERIOR REGIONS on both sides, not a narrow strip of ground. About 24 path cells and 40 open buildable cells. Exactly FOUR placed tower pieces and SIX small enemies, spacious otherwise. Only ONE tiny impact mark, no floating numbers or big explosions or particles. Towers and enemies have distinctive simple silhouettes, made of 3-6 main shapes with at most two tones per material; small compact assets, consistent scale, clean finish, no micro-texture. Path/buildable cells unambiguous. No scenery beyond the board, no decorative trees/rocks, no cliffs, no atmospheric lighting, no bokeh, no magical glow, no giant boss, no elaborate frame. This should look enjoyable and finished but deliberately modest and feasible for a small independent 2D game.
Composition: thin top status strip with 'WAVE 03', a heart '20', coin '120', pause icon. Main square board below strip. Beneath board a very compact row of FOUR tower icons. Bottom ~20% is a quiet readable question area with exact Korean text "'신중하다'의 뜻은?" and four simple answer buttons in a 2x2 arrangement: '조심스럽게 행동하다', '몹시 서두르다', '힘이 매우 세다', '소리가 매우 크다'. No other prose, no heading, no gradients in UI, no glass cards. Readable ordinary Korean sans font. Strong distinction of enemy/tower/path through shape, not only color. Maximum 7 palette colors excluding text. Avoid washed-out pastel palettes. Modest game artwork, generous visual breathing room. No external brand or existing IP. Style specifics follow:

variants.name: 잔디 보드
variants.prompt: Flat 2D cel-painted miniature strategy game. Mid green build tiles, dry tan path, charcoal outlines, cobalt friendly towers and brick red round goblin enemies. One bow tower, one short cannon, one flame brazier, one angular ice crystal. Slight expressive handmade edges but absolutely no texture. Rectangular S path. Muted natural midtones with strong blue/red accents, not pastel.

variants.name: 픽셀 전술판
variants.prompt: Deliberately coarse, charming 24px-style pixel sprites, nearest-neighbor crisp edges, no high-detail pixel wallpaper. Dark olive board, ochre path, cream grid highlights, cobalt and rust pieces. 8x8 square board with a three-turn zigzag route. Arrow turret, cannon, crystal, flag tower recognizable in about 24 pixels. Round beetle enemies. No antialiasing in game sprites; UI font can be clean.

variants.name: 나무 기물판
variants.prompt: A modern physical tabletop board translated into a flat digital strategy game. Warm walnut brown square board, ivory route tiles, deep forest-green empty cells. Compact solid wooden-looking tower tokens in blue, round enemy tokens in vermilion; just subtle single flat shadow, no wood grain rendering, no photorealism, no camera perspective. Towers have engraved simple bow/cannon/flame/snowflake symbols and different silhouettes. U-bending path across interior, ample placement cells.

variants.name: 회로 방어판
variants.prompt: Crisp flat sci-fi arcade graphics. Navy square arena, medium slate build tiles, ochre continuous S route. Off-white/cyan simple mechanical gun-turret silhouettes, orange red angular drone enemies. One amber single shot stroke only, no glow. Fine dark grid, modular chess-sized machines, not complex mech illustration. Consistent 2px technical outlines. Readable practical game UI.

variants.name: 만화 요새판
variants.prompt: Bold friendly 2D cartoon strategy board. Medium grass green and warm tan map, thick near-black ink contours on small towers, strong primary blue/red/yellow accents. Simple squashy goblin enemies with only eyes, no clothing detail. Cannon barrel, bow fork, flame cup, ice cone as strong compact tower shapes. Rounded clipped board corners but square grid. Editorially controlled large flat color shapes, not an elaborate cartoon scene.

variants.name: 석판 수비대
variants.prompt: Minimal carved-stone chess-like strategy game in FLAT TOP DOWN 2D. Slate gray squared board with sand colored winding road. Empty build tiles form generous square clusters. Ivory friendly towers with distinct rook, fork, disc cannon, crystal silhouettes, red black enemy pawns with small horns. Only 1 shadow tone and one highlight, tactile but no texture. Understated red/ivory/graphite palette with ochre path. Serious yet approachable, not gothic.

variants.name: 육각 전술판
variants.prompt: A compact HEXAGON-SHAPED bounded board of LARGE HEXAGONAL CELLS, entire board visible. A winding one-cell-wide path traverses interior and leaves many empty buildable hex cells inside, NOT circular route. About 40 cells total, roughly 15 path cells, 4 towers and6 enemies. Mid blue-gray/cream/ochre palette with red enemies and cobalt friendly pieces. Flat hex bases, simple 2D turrets, absolutely no 3D perspective. Replace square8x8 requirement only with this hex board; keep UI and sparse composition.

variants.name: 잉크 전술판
variants.prompt: Restrained clean hand-inked 2D game, cream board with charcoal thin grid, dark charcoal continuous bent road, crimson small enemy blobs, cobalt friendly simple towers. Selective hand-drawn line variation, no paper noise, no splatter, no decorative calligraphy. Compact towers drawn as recognizable tiny cannon/crossbow/crystal/brazier tokens. Almost black-and-white with only blue/red interaction accents. Square board clear and calm, playful not horror.

variants.name: 공장 조립판
variants.prompt: Flat toy-like INDUSTRIAL game sprites on a square steel tile board, middle gray build cells, ochre conveyor route making several rectangular turns through interior. Navy allied compact turrets, red one-eyed tiny robots. One screw mark per selected tower maximum, no texture, no industrial background, no hazard stripe borders, no ambient glow. Rounded mechanical shape language, one flat shadow per piece. Strong visibility of empty placement cells.

variants.name: 십자 섬 보드
variants.prompt: A compact CROSS-SHAPED BOARD formed by a square grid with only the four 2x2 corner regions removed. Entire board visible on plain dark blue backdrop, no scenic water texture. Saturated mid teal grass tiles, sandy tan S-shaped continuous interior route. Enough connected interior ground areas for building. Four compact cream/blue cannon and crystal tower pieces, six red crab tokens, no scenery trees, no beach decoration. Simple flat 2D game tiles, small crisp silhouettes and one-tone shadows. Override square silhouette only, retain square cells.
